source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = 0
    color = min((value for value in counts if value != background), key=lambda value: counts[value])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    r1, c1 = max(r for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    mask = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    mh, mw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == background for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''
